goal: Deliver SLOPOS-I X11/Openbox with a first-party Rust toolkit and minimum usable daily-app suite; NOT Wayland, PARAMA, Loom or unrelated repositories

tasks.title: Baseline, Linux guest, resource budget and evidence
tasks.acceptance: Record exact main SHA, current working app inventory, Linux VM bootstrap, baseline CI/Xvfb and disk budget without modifying host settings.

tasks.title: Text input, focus, accessibility and toolkit contracts
tasks.acceptance: Reusable Unicode text input/selection/IME and focus semantics, command actions, accessibility parity, Classic 1x/2x screenshot tests.

tasks.title: Menus, virtual lists, scroll, dialogs and chooser
tasks.acceptance: Keyboard and pointer menu/popover, virtualized lists/icons, scroll, modal/file chooser and clipboard with constrained memory.

tasks.title: Service provider truth and failure-state tests
tasks.acceptance: Network, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, audio, brightness, display and clock snapshots and safe mutations; missing hardware and permission errors are real.

tasks.title: Calculator regression and packaging proof
tasks.acceptance: Existing Calculator keyboard/pointer/accessibility and installed-launch workflow verified without cosmetic regression.

tasks.title: Filesystem model and safety invariants
tasks.acceptance: Read-only browse/list/select first, then transactional rename/copy/move/Trash with symlink, cross-device, overwrite, cancellation and error tests.

tasks.title: Image decoder and cache budget
tasks.acceptance: PNG/JPEG/common formats, orientation, encoded/decoded bounds and memory-safe thumbnail/cache behavior under malicious image fixtures.

tasks.title: Media backend and playback state
tasks.acceptance: Real decoder adapter and probe, seek/pause/volume/subtitles/time synchronization, malformed-media failure and audited codec licensing.

tasks.title: Curated installer authentication and transactions
tasks.acceptance: Signed trusted catalogue, checksum and publisher verification, safe install/uninstall staging, permission/rollback and cancellation.

tasks.title: Native Files user journeys
tasks.acceptance: Packaged native toolkit window: browse/up/back/select/open, copy/move/rename/Trash, fail-safe errors and real desktop file associations.

tasks.title: Native Image Viewer user journeys
tasks.acceptance: Expand PNG/SVG proof to JPEG/common formats, open dialog/association, fit/1x/zoom/pan/next/previous and real files.

tasks.title: Native video and audio player
tasks.acceptance: Native toolkit playback: open, play/pause, seek, volume, subtitles, proper frame/audio synchronization, graceful missing-codec flow.

tasks.title: Native Control Panels
tasks.acceptance: Replace required GTK settings screens with native network/audio/display/appearance/Bluetooth truth and permission/readback checks.

tasks.title: Native Software catalogue/install UI
tasks.acceptance: Replace GTK catalogue with native app using authenticated transactions, update/rollback, UI progress and trustworthy prompts.

tasks.title: Native shell status, OSD and notifications
tasks.acceptance: Native Wi-Fi/Bluetooth/clock popovers, volume/brightness OSD, notifications, Dock/menu/launcher parity and reduced motion.

tasks.title: Installed-X11 full release acceptance
tasks.acceptance: Installed Debian/Arch image tested with real click/key/AT-SPI, all apps, error/restart/logout, performance limits, visual references and release evidence on exact SHA.
